lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a regular coordinate matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges on the upper lateral flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with specular highlights on the upper edge and defined shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 6-8 small high-luminance blobs situated on the lower and anterior portions of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark circumferential line/constriction scar visible just posterior to the head; deep irregular notch and tissue loss on the trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct elongated dark-pixel silhouettes (commensal remoras) attached to the ventral surface.
